name: Sidestep (Dreamscarred Press)
body:
Discipline: clairsentience; Level: Marksman 2, Dread 2, psychic warrior 2

MANIFESTING

Display: Visual
Manifesting Time: 1 immediate action

EFFECT

Range: personal
Target: Self
Duration: instantaneous
Power Points: 3

DESCRIPTION

When you manifest this power, when you would normally be hit with an attack from a melee weapon, you may deflect it so that you take no damage from it.
